name: Ayagawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ayagawa town emblem in white: a stylised device of a loop and diagonal bands, like a river.
history: Municipal flag of Ayagawa, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 March 2006.

features.role: Ayagawa town emblem — a stylised device of a loop and diagonal bands, like a river
